assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production game background for Dune Relay, landscape mobile-first 2D walking adventure. Generate a polished wide 16:9 illustrated scene, at least 1920x1080 if possible. Style: richly detailed hand-painted storybook fantasy, crisp dark ink outlines, gently textured watercolor/gouache, warm brass machinery, clean readable shapes, matching a whimsical RaidGuild kingdom game, not pixel art, not photorealistic or 3D. Scene: a sturdy welcoming wooden river repair boat travelling upstream at early morning. Camera elevated side three-quarter view looking across its large open deck. The broad uncluttered wooden deck fills the lower 45 percent from left to right and provides a continuous walkable path for separately animated characters. Boat has low safe railings at its far edge, a small modest wheelhouse near back-left, a navigation table, secured supply crates, coiled ropes and brass pump/valves around perimeter, a bow toward right, no tall foreground obstructions across main walkway. Water visible around the hull and behind the deck, turquoise winding river, green farmland transitioning to warmer rocky banks and a few palms upstream toward the right, small recognizable pale fairytale castle with orange roofs far in distance downstream on left. Soft dawn mist and pale peach-blue sky, subtle lingering warm boat lanterns, hopeful fresh morning mood. Keep upper left and upper right reasonably quiet for small game HUD. Full bleed detailed environment, no border. CRITICAL: no people, no animals, no baked-in characters, no words, letters, labels, logos or watermarks. This is usable game scenery, not a poster or concept sheet.

assets.initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production 2D game character sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equally sized square frames, whole canvas aspect ratio 2:1 (2048x1024 preferred). Character: Skiff, a broad slightly scruffy anthropomorphic river otter pilot for a whimsical RaidGuild fantasy adventure. Clearly an otter animal, not human: rounded ears, expressive dark eyes, cream whiskered muzzle, brown fur, short stout legs with webbed paws, thick tapering otter tail. Upright stocky body, friendly practical middle-aged expression. Patched dark teal waterproof work overalls with rolled cuffs over a cream work shirt, faded rust-red neckerchief, brass round goggles resting on forehead, weathered waterproof leather chart case at hip, compact wooden boat hook carried close to body. Detailed hand-painted storybook fantasy with crisp dark ink outlines and gentle gouache shading, warm brass details, readable at small game scale, no pixel art, no 3D, no glossy plastic. Same exact outfit, body proportions, equipment, lighting and scale across all eight frames. Row 1: four full-body right-facing three-quarter side-view walk cycle frames: neutral standing, left foot forward, passing stride, right foot forward. Row 2: the same four phases facing left, opposite view, same identity. Each otter centered in its own invisible square cell, feet on consistent baseline with 7% padding all around, complete tail and boat hook inside each cell. Adjacent sprites must never touch. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard illustration, no paper texture outside characters. No scenery, no floor, no shadows, no grid lines, no captions, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Deliver an actual reusable uniform eight-frame sprite atlas, not a character concept poster.
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached eight-frame otter sprite sheet. Precisely remove all checkerboard, white/gray haze and background between and around the eight otters. Deliver a production PNG with truly empty fully transparent alpha=0 background and solid opaque alpha=255 character interiors, antialiased edges only. Preserve the same 4-column 2-row layout, exact Skiff identity, clothing, brass goggles, boat hook, poses, colors, full-body silhouettes, consistent cell positions and walk-cycle phases. Do not add texture outside characters. No grid, no ground shadow, no labels, no scenery. This must be a clean reusable sprite atlas that composites on a dark teal game background without a white rectangle, checkerboard or translucent character.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image shows Skiff, the otter pilot; use it only to preserve exact character identity and clothing, not the sheet composition. Create ONE square game dialogue avatar: circular portrait medallion, thin warm brass/gold rim, warm ivory paper inside the circle, truly transparent empty alpha=0 outside circle. Close head-and-upper-chest portrait of the same friendly stocky brown otter with cream whiskered muzzle, dark expressive eyes, brass goggles on forehead, rust-red neckerchief and dark teal patched waterproof overalls over cream shirt. Three-quarter view facing slightly toward viewer's right, confident kind expression with a little dry humor. Hand-painted gouache/storybook fantasy and crisp dark ink outlines, matching reference. Face large and readable in a tiny dialogue badge. No pole crossing face, no extra characters, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Portrait is opaque within circle, clean sharp antialiased outer edge with no checkerboard or haze.
